text: The Deputy Medical Officer of Health and the Director, Toronto Public Health will give a presentation on Review of Toronto Public Health to inform Strategic Planning.

The Board of Health – Strategic Plan Development Committee recommends that: 1. The Board of Health request the Medical Officer of Health to consider the comments and suggestions made during public presentations as part of developing the 2024-2028 Strategic Plan and as part of the forthcoming report-back to the April 24, 2024 Board of Health – Strategic Plan Development Committee meeting.
